key.definition: The name attributed to the field in the database, data to be uploaded, and data exports.

label.definition: The name attributed to the field in the front-end data entry, search, and field mapping modules.

measurementType.definition: The nature of the measurement, fact, characteristic, or assertion.
measurementType.comments: Included in the field metadata in DwC-A exports. Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary. This term has an equivalent in the dwciri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.
measurementType.examples: tail length | temperature | trap line length | survey area | trap type

measurementUnit.definition: The units associated with the dwc:measurementValue.
measurementUnit.comments: Included in the field metadata in DwC-A exports. Recommended best practice is to use the International System of Units (SI). This term has an equivalent in the dwciri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.
measurementUnit.examples: m | g | l | °C | mm | km² | % | hh:mm:ss

fieldHint.definition: Appears below front-end data entry element to provide user with guidance in data entry.

dataType.definition: Type of data front-end data entry element that will be provided to the user for data entry.

options.definition: Name options that will be provided through either a Single Taxon or Multi Taxa Autocomplete as autocomplete options for the user to select. If taxa options are provided here, no other taxa will be offered as autocomplete options.

calculation.definition: The JSON object containing the specifications for the calculation to be performed to calculate the value of this field.

calculation-minValue.definition: If a value is specified here, the front-end data entry element that displays this field value will turn from a light green background to light red if the calculated field value is lower than what is specified.

calculation-maxValue.definition: If a value is specified here, the front-end data entry element that displays this field value will turn from a light green background to light red if the calculated field value is higher than what is specified.

minValue.definition: If a value is specified here, the front-end data entry element will not allow values lower than the specified value to be entered.

maxValue.definition: If a value is specified here, the front-end data entry element will not allow values higher than the specified value to be entered.

roundValue.definition: If a value is specified here, the front-end data entry element will round values entered to the amount specied in decimal places.

step.definition: The amount in which an Incremental Number will increment or decrement when the up or down arrows are clicked.

maxlength.definition: If a value is specified here, text entry will be limited to the amount of characters specified.

showCounter.definition: If checked, a counter will display below the front-end data entry element to show how many characters have been entered and how many are allowed.

acceptedTaxaOnly.definition: If checked, Single Taxon or Multi Taxa Autocomplete data entry elements will only offer accepted taxa names as autocomplete options.

hideAuthor.definition: If checked, Single Taxon or Multi Taxa Autocomplete data entry elements will not display author names as autocomplete options.

hideProtected.definition: If checked, Single Taxon or Multi Taxa Autocomplete data entry elements will not offer protected taxa names as autocomplete options.

identifierName.definition: If a value is selected here, Single Taxon or Multi Taxa Autocomplete data entry elements will only offer taxa that have the selected identifier as autocomplete options.

identifierValue.definition: If a value is specified here, Single Taxon or Multi Taxa Autocomplete data entry elements will only offer taxa that have the selected identifier and the specified identifier value as autocomplete options.

kingdomId.definition: If a value is selected here, Single Taxon or Multi Taxa Autocomplete data entry elements will only offer taxa in the selected kingdom as autocomplete options.

limitToOptions.definition: If checked, Single Taxon or Multi Taxa Autocomplete data entry elements will only allow users to enter taxa that are offered as autocomplete options.

optionLimit.definition: Specifies the maximum amount of options that can be offered in a Single Taxon or Multi Taxa Autocomplete data entry element autocomplete options list.

parentTid.definition: If a taxon is specified here, Single Taxon or Multi Taxa Autocomplete data entry elements will only offer taxa that are subtaxa of the specified taxon as autocomplete options.

rankHigh.definition: If a taxonomic rank is selected here, Single Taxon or Multi Taxa Autocomplete data entry elements will only offer taxa that are of the selected taxonomic rank or higher as autocomplete options.

rankLimit.definition: If a taxonomic rank is selected here, Single Taxon or Multi Taxa Autocomplete data entry elements will only offer taxa that are of the selected taxonomic rank as autocomplete options.

rankLow.definition: If a taxonomic rank is selected here, Single Taxon or Multi Taxa Autocomplete data entry elements will only offer taxa that are of the selected taxonomic rank or lower as autocomplete options.

taxonType.definition: The type of taxonomic names that are to be offered as autocomplete options in the Single Taxon or Multi Taxa Autocomplete data entry element.

concatenator.definition: The character to be used to concatenate multiple taxonomic names together in the data entry values in Multi Taxa Autocomplete data entry elements.

identifier.definition: The taxonomic identifier that is to be used to populate the value for a Taxon Identifier data entry element.

definition.definition: The text that will be displayed in the definition section of the information popup for the front-end data entry element.

comments.definition: The text that will be displayed in the comments section of the information popup for the front-end data entry element.

examples.definition: The text that will be displayed in the examples section of the information popup for the front-end data entry element.

source.definition: The url that will be used in the "Go to source" link in the information popup for the front-end data entry element.
